title: external_run output
description: How the run ended, and its result when it may be given. A run the server failed, or a result screening withheld, is answered with that outcome, never an error.

outcome.description: succeeded (the server answered and the result passed screening), failed (the server answered an error or couldn't be reached) or withheld (the result matched a high-severity screening rule and was discarded).

result.description: What the server returned: its structured content, else its content blocks; null unless the outcome is succeeded.

text.description: The result as text: its text blocks, else its structured content as JSON, at most 20,000 characters.

category.description: The screening category of a withheld result; empty otherwise.

error.description: Why it failed or was withheld, or the error the tool answered; empty otherwise.

tested.description: Always false: EuKollab hasn't tested an external agent.
